xna-type.name: ContentManager
xna-type.summary: The ContentManager is the run-time component which loads managed objects from the binary files produced by the design time content pipeline. It also manages the lifespan of the loaded objects, disposing the content manager will also dispose any assets which are themselves IDisposable.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of ContentManager.

parameters.parameter: The service provider that the ContentManager should use to locate services.

constructor.remarks: Warning When creating a new ContentManager , if no instance of Game is otherwise required by the application, it is often better to create a new class that implements the IServiceProvider interface rather than creating an instance of Game just to create a new instance of GraphicsDeviceManager . By default, the ContentManager searches for content in the directory where the executable is located.

property.name: RootDirectory
property.summary: Gets the root directory associated with this ContentManager.

property.name: ServiceProvider
property.summary: Gets the service provider associated with the ContentManager.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Releases the unmanaged resources used by the ContentManager and optionally releases the managed resources.

overload.summary: Releases the unmanaged resources used by the ContentManager and optionally releases the managed resources.

parameters.parameter: true to release both managed and unmanaged resources; false to release only unmanaged resources.

overload.summary: Releases all resources used by the ContentManager class.

method.name: OpenStream
method.summary: Opens a stream for reading the specified asset. Derived classes can replace this to implement pack files or asset compression.

overload.summary: Opens a stream for reading the specified asset. Derived classes can replace this to implement pack files or asset compression.

parameters.parameter: The name of the asset being read.

method.name: Unload
method.summary: Disposes all data that was loaded by this ContentManager.

overload.summary: Disposes all data that was loaded by this ContentManager.
